en: If people having no confidence get bravery from seeing me and hearing my melodies, then my career is one of great value.
Shinada-san, I've never seen Daddy open up like this... Guess that's what the sake's for.

Oh boy. Daddy's had a few too many sips, it appears. Perhaps
we'd best be on our way.
I'm sorry, Shinada-san, but here's my wallet. Can you settle the tab, please? I'll take Daddy outside for some fresh air.
What's wrong? You done already?
*huff* *cough* Damn it! I lost! I'm never going to make it out of the qualifiers!
What're you talking about?
I'm in the Victory Road tournament. I thought you were, too.
A tournament run by a bunch of rich guys. They have some serious prize money for whoever proves to be the ultimate streetfighter in Japan.
Never heard of it.
You're in a special category... Kazuma Kiryu-san.
I help run the Victory Road tournament. It's an underground fighting contest with qualifiers held concurrently all over Japan.
Like I said, never heard of it. Anyway, you got the wrong guy. I'm not Kazuma Kiryu.
Very well. Taichi Suzuki-san will do just fine.
Most of the entrants already assume that you'll participate.
After all, a man of your stature can't ever truly melt into the crowd, even outside of Kamurocho. Isn't that right, "Suzuki-san"?
A certain tournament entrant told us you were in town. Perhaps you'd like to speak to him directly.
Where would I find him?
Ose Bridge. His name is Ren Higashino.
I don't know anyone by that name.
He's just another young fighter trying to make a name for himself.
Now, if you'll excuse me.
(Ren Higashino... He said he'd be over on Ose Bridge.)
Argh! I can't believe there's such a strong contender in a local qualifier.
But you better watch yourself. I hear Valery Garrett's here in town.
Valery Garrett...
He's a regular at the Underground Coliseum over in Tokyo. Made a pretty big name for himself over there.
He's racked up win after win since he entered Victory Road. And they say he's not even trying.
Even so, no one's been able to touch him. But someone like you might have a chance.
(So Valery Garrett's in town. We've slugged it out at the Underground Coliseum in Purgatory before.)
Come on, that all ya got?
Dammit! Why can't I beat you?
(That one didn't seem like an ordinary street punk.)
That was an impressive fight, Taiga Saejima-san.
We've been watching you. It would seem you've been trying to avoid attention.
That man you just defeated is in the qualifying round of the Victory Road tournament.
Victory Road?
The Victory Road is an underground fighting contest with qualifiers held concurrently all over Japan.
Its sole purpose is to find the ultimate fighter in all of Japan. As for me? I help run the tournament.
What's this got to do with me?
Anyone as strong as you are has everything to do with our tournament.
But be warned. From now on, other Victory Road contenders will be gunning for you.
Defeat all the contenders here in town, and I'll see you at the finals. Can you become the Ultimate Fighter, Saejima-san?
And if I got other things to do?
You'll come around. Your kind always does.
(Sounds like another pain in the ass.)
Shit! Lost again!
Whaddya mean, "again"? You been going around pickin' fights all day?
Yeah. I'm in the Victory Road qualifier, but just a few minutes ago, I ran into this dude claiming to be the best fighter in Japan.
He wasn't as good as he thinks, though. Don't get me wrong. He's no pushover, either, but that's why losing to him really pissed me off.
So you were tryin' to take it out on me then?
It's not just me. There's a ton of other guys who're pissed off because they lost to him.
What's his name?
Better be careful if you're going up against Tokita. He's got a way of getting under your skin.
Tokita? The Tokita from Sodachi Dojo?
Had enough yet?
(That was no ordinary street punk.)
(He must be pretty confident in his fighting skills if he's that upset about losing.)
That was an impressive fight, Shun Akiyama-san.
Hm? Who're you?
I help run the Victory Road tournament. I look forward to seeing much more of you.
Its sole purpose is to find the ultimate fighter in the nation. And that man you just defeated? He was in the qualifying round.
That still doesn't explain why he was so eager to pick a fight with me.
It's simple. You're a possible contender.
We've had our eye on you. You seem to be a formidable fighter.
Defeat all the contenders here in town, and I'll see you at the finals. Can you become the Ultimate Fighter, Akiyama?
And what if I'm not interested?
You'll come around. Your kind always does. Now, if you'll excuse me.
(I wasn't looking for trouble, but it seems it came looking for me.)
Hey, pal! I need you to follow that <Color:22>white car<Color:Default> up ahead. But don't let them see you!
The car up there?
Yeah, they're bad guys. I may not look it, but I'm a police officer. Come on, let's roll!
Aww, shit!
Gah! They took off! What do we do now!?
Want me to go after them?
Yeah, go get them!
Damn it. You lost them. I guess this was too much to ask of a taxi driver.
(It seems I let him down. I'll have to step up my game.)
Heheh. I've got you now!
Oh shit!
Haha! I've been after you guys for a while!
And now I've caught you in the act... Oh no!
Looks like I forgot my badge. Damn. I bet it ended up in the wash.
Come on, now's our chance!
Heheh. What a clown.
Hm. Guess I'll just have to wipe the floor with you guys myself.
What did you say? You should've stuck to driving, old man.
Get him!
Damn. I guess this was too much to ask of a taxi driver.
Ow ow ow...
Huh!? What happened?
Who did that to them?
Don't you remember? You took them down yourself.
You must have hit your head during the fight.
Yeah? Huh. Well, I'd better call it in and haul these guys off to the station.
Thanks for the help, pal! They would have slipped through our fingers without you!
Remember to check your pockets before you do the wash next time.
Yeah. My mom's been telling me that since I was a kid. I'll ask for you by name next time.
(Everything seems to have worked out well.)
Whew... How many does that make it now?
Dang, you're fast! I never thought I'd run into someone like you here.
But you know, there's another guy who's gone undefeated so far.
They say he was born to be a martial artist. His fighting skills are in a whole other league compared to regular street fighters.
Even you would be no match for him.
Head over to the <Color:7>Sotenbori Footpath<Color:Default> if you're curious. Good luck, hehe.
(<Color:7>Sotenbori Footpath<Color:Default>, huh? Maybe I'll go check it out sometime.)
Why do you guys keep picking fights with me?
(He seems stronger than your average street punk. Probably been in a lot of fights.)
Excuse me. Are you Tatsuo Shinada-san?
Man... Yeah, who's asking?
Allow me to explain. The Victory Road is an underground fighting contest with qualifiers held concurrently all over Japan.
Yeah, sure, cool. But what does that have to do with me?
We've had our eye on you. You seem to be a rather formidable fighter.
Wait, what does any of this have to do with me!? I've never even heard of your damn tournament!
The winner will be granted the proud title of Ultimate Fighter. Oh, and then there's the prize money.
Wait, did you just say prize money? Is it a lot?
Defeat all the contenders here in town, and I'll see you at the finals. Can you become the Ultimate Fighter, Shinada-san?
I haven't agreed to enter yet, you know.
(The Victory Road qualifiers... I suppose it's worth a shot if there's some prize money in it for me.)
You better not get in our way, asshole!
Yuta! Oh god...
Mom! Help!
Let the kid go. You and I need to have a little talk.

You think we're just gonna sit down and chat!? Nice fuckin'
try! Now if you don't scram this instant, we're putting you
in the ground!
Wait... Is that you, Itoda-san?
Do you know this guy?
I can't see his face, but I recognize that voice. I think he's a former employee of ours. My husband fired him the other day for embezzling company funds.
But I gave the money back! And now I'm in debt up to my eyeballs. This was my only play!
Please, Itoda-san! Let Yuta go! I promise I won't tell the police!
This isn't how I thought it'd go down... I went about it all wrong!
I should have kidnapped the wife along with the kid! Look at all this extra bullshit I have to go through!
You're coming along for the ride, too, mystery man. I'm taking all your asses hostage! Now get over here!
What? Don't give me that look. You want me to turn you into worm food!?

You really have no idea how much pain you're causing these
people... Maybe I need to give you a taste of it firsthand.

Yeah? Well, how 'bout I make you taste your own <Italic>blood</Italic>
firsthand!? Your corpse won't even look human by the time we're done with you!
Sorry... I couldn't do it. Those guys were too fast.
Oh no... What about my little boy!?
I hope he's okay. Have you called the police?
Yes. But who knows if they'll ever find that car?
Mom! I was so scared...
Thank you so much! You aren't hurt, are you?
Don't worry about me. I'm just glad you two are okay. Now what should we do with these guys...
I've already called the police. They'll be here any moment.
Oh, come on! Give us a break, lady! You got your kid back alive, didn't you!?
You're not getting off the hook that easy! Do you seriously think giving back the money and the kid makes up for what you did!?

You need to wake up and realize you can't just do whatever
you want, using your problems as an excuse. But I'm sure
you'll have plenty of time to think about that behind bars.
Why you... Who the hell are you, anyway? You sure don't act like a taxi driver!
I really appreciate what you've done. If it wasn't for you, who knows what would have happened to Yuta? I can't thank you enough.
Hey, don't worry about it. I just happened to be in the right place at the right time.

There must be something I can do to express my gratitude.
Here, this is the least I can give you.

I'll never forget the way you helped us today! I hope you
know how wonderful you are...
For real! You kicked some royal ass back there, sir!
Nice driving.
Your driving's all right, I guess.
Your driving's terrible.
(What's with that car?)
Oh? What's the Spangled Meteor doing around here?
Wada-san... You know about this car?
Why, is this the first time you've seen it?
It is. There something special about it?
Well sure. The lady who drives this sexy piece of machinery is in charge of the Vixen Zeroes. They call her the Spangled Meteor.
And what's the Vixen Zeroes?
They say they're a group of gorgeous women who can outspeed anyone they challenge. Wish they'd drive up on <Italic>me</Italic> someday!
So they're essentially an all-girl street racing team?
According to the stories, yeah. But I've never heard of anyone who's actually seen their faces.
Then they may not be gorgeous at all.
Haha, that's about the size of it. Guess you could say it's one of those urban legends.
Oh, and apparently, the only way to see them is to beat them in a race.
Interestingly enough, the Vixen Zeroes are usually the ones who initiate the challenges.
If you lose, they just speed off. But if you win? You catch a glimpse of true beauty.
But if nobody's ever seen them in person, does that mean they're undefeated?
Who knows? All I've heard are rumors. Sure makes a good story, though, don't you think?
Heh. I guess you're right.
Excuse me. You wouldn't happen to be Suzuki-san from Nagasu Taxi, would you?
Who's asking?
I'm with the Vixen Zeroes. Our leader has a message for you.
On behalf of the Vixen Zeroes, the Spangled Meteor wishes to challenge you to a race. She's ready and waiting, whenever you can come.
Why does she want to race me? I'm just a taxi driver.
The Spangled Meteor is well aware of your exploits. And perhaps you're well aware of hers. Does that give you a hint?
(It must be that girl, Nanami. So she <Italic>was</Italic> the Spangled Meteor!)
What do you say, Suzuki-san? Ready to race?
Sorry, but I can't be doing that.
I figured you might say that. Well, let me know if you ever change your mind. The invitation's always open.
It seems the rumors about Suzuki the taxi driver were true.
Rena Nanami... Or should I say, the Spangled Meteor?
